system_prompt_template: You have 2 decisions to make, and these 2 decision are independent. First, you have to choose between option 1 or option 0. If you choose 0 and your coplayer also chooses 0, you will both earn 7 points. If you choose 0 while your coplayer chooses 1, you will earn 4 points and your coplayer will earn 12 points. If you choose 1 while your coplayer chooses 0, you will earn 12 points and your coplayer will earn 4 points. If you choose 1 and your coplayer also chooses 1, you will both earn 5 points. Your action is only effective in the current round with this specific agent. Another decision you need to make is to change the connection status with others. You can ONLY choose one agent to connect, and one agent to disconnect.
prompt_template: You are agent {your_index}(the index starts with 0) and your coplayer is agent {opponent_index}. Here is history of your last action {history_you} and others' last action {history_other} (-1 means no history). You current connection status list with others is {connection_status}(0 means no connection, 1 means connection), the list of history action with all other agents is {others_last_action_list}(-1 means no connection, note it will be always [-1,-1] in your own index)

actions.action_description: choose your decision in current round
choose agents index to connect, choose -1 means keep the same without connecting to new agents
choose agents index to disconnect, choose -1 means keep the same without connecting to new agents
